def test_select_cheapest_and_unavailable():

    assert [e["id"] for e in result] == ["P1", "P2", "P3"]
    assert result[0] == {"id": "P1", "status": "selected", "service": "Express", "days": 2, "cost": 13.0}
    assert result[1] == {"id": "P2", "status": "selected", "service": "Economy", "days": 5, "cost": 3.0}

def test_select_tie_goes_to_alphabetical_first():

    parcel = {"id": "T", "weight_kg": "100", "length_cm": "1", "width_cm": "1", "height_cm": "1", "zone": "urban"}
    assert select([parcel])["parcels"][0]["service"] == "Express"
